deprecation_criterion: Superseded by the next prioritize housekeep wave's baseline; single-use measured-reduction reference, re-captured whenever a feature change legitimately alters the doc surfaces.
description: Line counts of prioritize doc surfaces, re-captured after issue #257 (title-prefix feature detection for label-less issues) legitimately added behaviour to docs/spec.md. The prior baseline (spec.md=144, contract.md=31, captured post-#214) recorded an honest doc-reduction NO-OP; this revision raises spec.md to the post-#257 surface (spec.md=153, contract.md unchanged at 31) because the hardened detection is a genuine feature addition, not silent doc bloat. The housekeep e2e gates continue to assert behavior preserved, no load-bearing token dropped, and that the docs do not drift PAST this new baseline.
